About our farm:

Glenview Acres is managed using regenerative practices to rebuild soil health. We believe the health of soil, animals, and people are all intrinsically connected!

Our beef is 100% grass-fed from start to finish. No grain ever!

Our pork is pasture-raised and rotated regularly to fresh ground. We feed only certified organic grain to supplement their pasture diet.

How It Works

Place your reservation deposit below and include a preferred processing month in your checkout notes. You'll hear back from us shortly!

Our butcher, Homestead Acres, is located just outside Mt Hope, which is the gateway to Amish Country. There are many popular attractions in the area if you want to make a day of it. Make sure to check out The Red Mug Coffee Shop in Mt Hope!

Meet your farmers

Joe & Jen Lautzenheiser

We discovered our shared passion for real food and farming during a coffeeshop date back in 2017. Our daydreams about transforming the conventionally-run family farm eventually became a vision for the future.

The corn and bean fields were transitioned to perennial grasses, countless fence posts were pounded, and within a couple years, the farm was unrecognizable with cattle, sheep, pigs, and chickens, all rotationally grazing and building back the depleted soil.

Our vision for Glenview Acres is really very simple. We want the farm to be life-giving. Building soil, instead of depleting it. Honoring the design of animals. And producing the kind of nourishing food that we personally want to eat and feed our family.

We are thrilled to share it with you!

Joe & Jen Lautzenheiser & family
